Description: Rooftop solar installation subsidy providing 40% financial assistance for residential households, reducing electricity bills.
Department / Ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Eligibility Criteria: Residential households with grid connectivity; Rooftop area available; Annual income under ₹8,00,000
Required Documents: Aadhaar, Electricity Bill; Bank Documents; Property Tax Receipt
Benefits: Direct subsidy up to ₹78,000 transferred to bank account
Application Process: 1. Register on National Portal for Rooftop Solar (solarrooftop.gov.in)\n2. Submit DISCOM approval\n3. Install through empanelled vendor

Description: Financial aid and input subsidies for small and marginal farmers across Maharashtra.
Eligibility Criteria: Farmers in Maharashtra with landholding up to 5 acres; Age between 18 to 65
Required Documents: Aadhaar; 7/12 Extract; Land Documents, Bank Documents
Application Process: Apply through Aaple Sarkar portal or CSC centre

Description: Monthly stipend and internship opportunities in top 500 companies for youth aged 21-24.
Eligibility Criteria: Youth aged 21 to 24; Not employed full-time; Family income <= 5 Lakh
Required Documents: Aadhaar, Education Certificates; PAN; Bank Documents
Benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹5,000 plus one-time grant of ₹6,000
Application Process: Register on PM Internship portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in) and choose company vacancies
